name: Lians
description: Gives any AI agent durable memory across chats, sessions, tools, and models through a local-first MCP server, SDKs, and an optional hosted API.

skills.name: Remember Durable Facts
skills.description: Stores facts and decisions under a stable agent identity so they remain available across later chats, tools, and model providers.

skills.name: Recall Relevant Context
skills.description: Uses semantic search to retrieve relevant memories for the current task instead of replaying an agent's full conversation history.

skills.name: Inspect And Correct Memory
skills.description: Lets people list, inspect, correct, and explicitly delete stored memories rather than leaving agent context as an opaque black box.

skills.name: Query Memory Over Time
skills.description: Supports point-in-time queries over bitemporal records so agents can distinguish what was true from when the system learned it.
